name: Admin Send Proposal Email (Sent+)
description: Admin sends a proposal email from the Enviar correo tab once the proposal is sent or beyond. Each send writes ProposalChangeLog with EMAIL_SENT change type and updates last_activity_at. Reuses the same composer UI as branded email via mode prop (per-section Markdown toggle + server-rendered preview via POST /api/emails/preview/). Endpoints: POST /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/send/, GET /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/defaults/, GET /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/history/, POST /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/markdown-attachment/.
